dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're too kind. It's just a couple of work chants I made up to keep myself going.

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: If you really like music, you should go to the troupe in Snezhnograd. Compared to my rough old voice, that's what you'd call real art.

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I learned these little tunes I'm humming now from a famous singer who happened to be passing through when I was young.
